'''LEE'''K<br>'''LEE'''CH<br>'''LEE'''WAY

== 90% ==
Which of these photographs has to be wrong?

[[File:Polar bear.png|frameless]]

'''B''': Polar bears live in the Arctic and not deserts.

== 80% ==
Which of these pictures is the odd one out?

[[File:Odd one out 3.png|frameless]]

'''D''': When said out loud they become letters of the alphabet. Pea is P, eye is I, and bee is B. The hammer is just a hammer.

== 60% ==
A mother and father have three daughters. Each daughter has one brother. How many children do the mother and father have in total?

The daughters all have the same brother, so there are '''four''' of them altogether.

== 50% ==
If planet ‘Earth’ has a ‘Heart’ which body parts does ‘Mars’ have?

Heart is an anagram of Earth, and '''Arms''' is an anagram of Mars.

== 45% ==
Crack the code to deduce this two-word phrase:

[[File:Top secret.png|frameless]]

'''Top Secret'''

== 40% ==
What type of vehicle can go before ‘ITY’, ‘ISH’ and ‘GUARD’ to make words?

'''Van'''ity '''Van'''ish '''Van'''guard

== 35% ==
Crack the code below:

[[File:Crack code.png|frameless]]

'''4''': The number relates to how many times the lines cross.

== 30% ==
If you spell numbers out backwards, so that ‘one’ becomes ‘eno’, ‘two’ becomes ‘owt’ etc, what is the next number that spells a common word?

‘'''ten'''’ spelt backwards becomes ‘net’.

== 25% ==
Which is the odd one out?

[[File:Mouse.png|frameless]]

The pictures are of things which all sound the same – Pause, Paws, Pours – except '''C''' which is a mouse.

== 20% ==
If Jack turned 17 yesterday and he’ll turn 18 this year, what date is his birthday?

If yesterday was '''December 31st''' that means today is January 1st of a new year. So he was 17 last year and will be 18 at the end of this year.

== 15% ==
If the 3rd of March, 8th of November and 9th of September are all the same, then what in October is also the same?

The 3rd letter of March, the 8th letter of November and the 9th letter of September is an R, and R is the '''7th''' letter of October.

== 10% ==
How many pets does Stella have in total if all except two are dogs, all except two are cats, and all except two are rabbits?

'''3'''

== 5% ==
Fill in the blank

Jessica is Mandy’s only sister. Mandy is the '''NAME''' of Jessica’s sister.

== 1% ==

T N E C R E P E '''N O'''

It’s ‘one percent’ spelt backwards
